forecasts.question: Will Russian drones or missiles enter NATO airspace between 1 and 30 September 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: A NATO member's government confirms a Russian drone or missile in its airspace in the period.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Incursions occurred in 9 of the previous 12 months.

updates.note: Strikes near the Polish border intensified.

forecasts.resolution_note: Two Russian drones entered Polish airspace on 12 September.

forecasts.question: Will any NATO member request Article 4 consultations between 15 September and 15 October 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: A NATO member formally requests consultations under Article 4.
forecasts.resolution_note: No member requested consultations in the period.
EU leaders ended the summit without adopting the 20th package.
forecasts.question: Will EU leaders adopt a 20th sanctions package against Russia by 25 October 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: The Council of the EU announces adoption of the 20th package on or before 25 October 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Most earlier packages were adopted within a month of their target date, a few after vetoes.

forecasts.question: Will Finland or Estonia charge anyone over the October 2026 Gulf of Finland cable damage by 31 January 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: A Finnish or Estonian prosecutor announces charges connected to the 16 October 2026 cable damage.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Two of seven Baltic cable cases since 2023 led to charges within four months.

updates.note: Another incursion raises the chance that Poland requests Article 4 consultations.

forecasts.question: Will Poland request NATO Article 4 consultations before 31 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Poland formally requests consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Poland has requested Article 4 consultations once since 2022.

forecasts.question: Will the IAEA report a complete loss of off-site power at Zaporizhzhia before 31 December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: An IAEA statement reports that the plant lost all off-site power, however briefly.
forecasts.base_rate_note: The plant lost all off-site power about once every three months since 2022.

forecasts.question: Will the EU adopt its 20th sanctions package against Russia by 30 November 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: The Council of the EU announces adoption of the 20th package on or before 30 November 2026.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Earlier packages blocked at a summit were usually adopted within five weeks.

forecasts.question: Will a Russian drone or missile enter Polish airspace between 29 October and 27 November 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Polish Operational Command or the defence ministry confirms at least one Russian drone or missile in Polish airspace in the period.
forecasts.base_rate_note: Polish airspace saw at least one incursion in 7 of the last 12 months.
